column1: # phone-app-suites.tsv — the suites in this directory that test ONLY a phone app.
# The CEO, 2026-09-26: "the native mobile apps are 2 COMPLETELY INDEPENDENT DIFFERENT APPS ...
# So, WHY THE FUCK ARE THEY PART OF THE SAME FUCKING BUILD???"
# `run-tests.sh --for desktop` (the desktop nightly's script-suites gate) leaves every suite named
# here out. `run-tests.sh --for ios`, `--for android` and `--for phone` run only them, and the
# phone app's own release steps call those (richos/mobile/native-ios/Release/README.md,
# richos/mobile/native-android/README.md). Every suite here still runs at land whenever one of
# its own `# run-tests: inputs` changes, because proof-for.sh selects by inputs and never reads
# this file.
# One row per suite: <suite><TAB><ios | android | ios,android><TAB><why it tests only that app>.
# run-tests.sh refuses the whole list, before anything runs, if a row names no suite, has no
# reason, names another app, or names a suite whose covers row claims a file the Mac app ships
# (richos/app/src-tauri, richos/app/crates, richos/app/ui, richos/web/web-app, richos/engine).
# NOT here, on purpose, though they read richos/mobile/ (the Mac side of the phone connection):
#   mobile-mac.test.sh          the phone server compiled into the Mac app's own crate
#                               (app/src-tauri/src/main.rs, mobile_mac_server), under cargo test
#   native-conformance.test.sh  the Mac's production request verifier (app/src-tauri/src/phone)
#                               against the corpus both phone apps must pass
#   mobile-pwa.test.sh          the phone web app the Mac executable embeds and serves
#                               (app/src-tauri/build.rs, embed_phone), in Chromium and WebKit
#   mobile-headless.test.sh     covers web/web-app/lib/voice.js and lib/connection.js, which the
#                               Mac embeds, as well as the shared mobile core
# A suite nobody lists runs in the desktop build.
native-ios-app.test.sh
